title: A Rust-Colored Whisper
narration: Half the size of Earth. One hundred times colder than home. Mars glows red with rust, a world both familiar and alien.
visual_goal: Opening shot of Mars against black space, slowly rotating, showing its red surface and polar ice caps.
search_queries: Mars surface rust color red planet

title: The Long Road
narration: Fifty-four to four hundred million kilometers away. In 1965, Mariner 4 sailed past, returning 22 images. Then, silence.
visual_goal: Animation or montage showing Earth to Mars distance scale, then grainy black-and-white Mariner 4 image sequence.

title: First Touch
narration: In 1971, Soviet Mars 3 landed. It transmitted for just 14 seconds. A heartbeat. Then the red dust swallowed the signal.
visual_goal: Historical reenactment or illustration of Mars 3 lander on dusty surface, signal drop graphic.

title: We Stayed
narration: Curiosity has rolled over 30 kilometers since 2012. Ingenuity flew 72 times. Perseverance gathers rocks for Earth. They work while we watch.
visual_goal: Time-lapse of rover tracks on Martian surface, cut to Ingenuity helicopter flying, then sample tubes.

title: The Next Step
narration: Olympus Mons towers 21.9 kilometers high. Valles Marineris carves deep. Mars is a land of extremes. One day, boots will walk here. Our footprints.
visual_goal: Sweeping aerial view of Olympus Mons and Valles Marineris, then fade to ascending rocket silhouette on Martian horizon.
